🛡️ Windows Safe Installation & Verification Guide

Official guidance ensuring Windows users can verify, install, and run the software safely according to Microsoft best practices.

1

SHA-256 Integrity Verification

To verify that your downloaded installer matches the authentic build, open Windows PowerShell and run:

Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\AlePdf-0.15.0-windows-x64-setup.exe

The computed hash must match the published hash: 5ef1c9eaabc9... shown above.

2

Microsoft Defender & SmartScreen

AlePdf is open source and cleanly packaged to comply with Microsoft Defender security scans.

Because expensive enterprise Authenticode certificates ($400+/yr) are not yet acquired for this independent open-source project, Windows SmartScreen may display an "Unrecognized app" prompt. Click "More info" and then "Run anyway" to proceed.

3

Lowest Privilege & Clean Uninstall

The installer requires no administrative elevation (PrivilegesRequired: lowest) and installs into user profile (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\AlePdf).

Zero background services, telemetry daemons, or hidden tasks. Full, clean uninstallation is supported via Windows Settings ▸ Installed apps or Control Panel.

CORE ARCHITECTURAL PILLARS

Six principles guiding every tool we build.

Every application in our suite adheres to strict performance, transparency, and data privacy commitments.

01 / PERFORMANCE

Native & Blazing Fast

Built with Swift and Rust rather than heavy web runtimes. Fully utilizes hardware acceleration on Apple Silicon and modern x64 processors.

02 / PRIVACY

Private by Default

Your documents, caches, and clipboard data never leave your computer. Zero surveillance, background tracking, or mandatory accounts.

03 / EXPERIENCE

Platform Authentic Feel

Complies with Apple Human Interface Guidelines for macOS and fluent system aesthetics for Windows, ensuring native controls and shortcuts.

04 / TRANSPARENCY

Open Source & Independent

Codebases are published openly on GitHub. No predatory licensing, stealth subscription charges, or embedded advertisements.

05 / EFFICIENCY

Low Memory & Battery Friendly

Minimal RAM footprint and energy-efficient GPU pipelines ensure your laptop battery remains uncompromised.

06 / AUTOMATION

Agent & CLI Ready

Equipped with CLI commands and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations ready for modern AI coding agents and local workflows.
